title: Google Search Senior Design System UX Engineer: Live Drill Masterclass
description: Two-host spoken engineering peer review generated using Gemini native multi-speaker audio (gemini-3.8-flash-tts with Aoede and Algenib). Covers live technical rehearsal for the Google Search Design System UX Engineer role with hiring manager Mindy Deli Carpini: the 90-second positioned pitch, Google exit framing, Wiz 3-layer architecture, latency/CLS defense, accessible combobox typeahead, and Cloud AI conflict resolution.
